These slide decks are used in training delivered by OBIS. They're Markdown, built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and reveal.js, and openly licensed ([CC BY‑NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/)). Reuse them freely by [forking the repo](https://github.com/iobis/obis_edna_slides).
